description.text: Startups will work alongside world leading energy utilities from around the globe to deliver cutting edge solutions and co-create the future of energy.

targetApplicants.text: For the past decade, Free Electrons has brought together startups , utilities , and ecosystem partners to co-create the future of energy. This milestone celebrates a decade of innovation and collaboration while marking the start of a new chapter in our shared journey to advance the energy transition. Through Free Electrons, startups and leading global utilities join forces to pilot breakthrough solutions, scale technologies through commercial deployment, unlock investment opportunities, and accelerate collective learning and growth.
